sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the pleading standard for securities fraud. The dispute centers on whether a complaint must identify specific evidence of intent to deceive. The lower court found the complaint sufficient. NVIDIA seeks reversal. The fund seeks affirmance.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the evidentiary threshold for securities fraud claims. It determines how much detail plaintiffs must provide at the pleading stage. The outcome shapes the balance between access to courts and protection from baseless suits.
